description_excerpt: Main Responsibilities: • To be trained for delivery of overall logistics service to customer • Liaise with customers on an ad-hoc basis when solving serious operational problems or dealing with complaints • Provide support to other projects within the office when called upon • Within the limits of the role be accountable for project delivery to time and budget as well as expected results for customer satisfaction • Assure the project execution is following policies, procedures, systems, and requirements approved • Ensure project shipment processing is executed in line with quality & safety…
